english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when revealing hidden information by telling it.

exampleSentences.english: They finally reveal that there is a problem with the contract.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢終於講出嚟，原來份合約有問題。

english.note: Use this when someone succeeds or fails to put a thought, reason, or feeling into words.

exampleSentences.english: They finally managed to articulate why they were so angry.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢終於講出嚟點解咁嬲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 gong2 ceot1 lei4 dim2 gaai2 gam3 nau1
